args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The three earlier parties never left Manufactory Nine because they were trapped in a repeating one-hour loop [2]. The loop begins when someone crosses the threshold and ends approximately one hour later, at which point the hour "starts again" [2]. Those inside who cannot "feel" the loop forget each entire turn and experience it as a fresh start [2]. Consequently, these parties are not dead, but have been continuously walking into the building for nine years [2].

The mechanism of the loop and the difference in memory between Odeline Marran and the others is explained as follows:

*   **The Cause:** The loop was created when the Lumen Concern dug for lumen and struck "the Whole," causing space to fold and time to catch [5]. This resulted in a state where the building collapsed during the first turn of the loop and has continued to collapse during every subsequent turn since [5].
*   **Why others forget:** When the hour turns, anyone who cannot "hold the deep Facets back" is reset to the top of the stairs, forgetting the previous attempts [3, 7]. For example, a character named Vasht was reset to the threshold, forgetting he had ever reached the candle [3].
*   **Why Ode remembers:** Odeline Marran is able to remember because she is one of the few who can withstand the reset; she has been living the same hour for nine years [6]. She has watched the shaft fold and unfold "a thousand times" and knows the timing of the loop to the breath [7].
